profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Full-Stack Developer with a BS in Computer Science and Electrical Engineering, I bring a comprehensive skill set and hands-on experience in building scalable and high-performance systems. I am proficient in languages and technologies such as Java, C/C++, Docker, and am well-versed in both monolithic and microservices architectures. My expertise extends to designing and communicating software architectures, ensuring seamless integration across teams, and executing complex solutions that meet user needs and business goals.

I thrive in high-throughput, low-latency systems environments, where I work to optimize performance and reliability. I have a deep understanding of database prototyping, including managing complex remote database connections, and I excel at troubleshooting, debugging, and upgrading existing systems to enhance functionality and efficiency.

In addition to my technical expertise, I am experienced in implementing CI/CD pipelines, managing releases, and ensuring smooth deployments. I am skilled at coordinating cross-functional teams, ensuring efficient collaboration, and delivering robust, user-centric solutions on time.

With a strong foundation in UI design and integration, as well as Bluetooth Low Energy engineering, I focus on building clean, reliable code and leading teams towards achieving exceptional results. My goal is to continue growing as a software engineer, consistently driving innovation and excellence in every project I undertake

Let's connect and explore possibilities!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer, I specialize in designing robust, scalable architecture for high-throughput, low-latency systems. My core development work is in Java, with frequent use of C++, and I leverage containerized environments through Docker alongside modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth and reliable deployment.

In my role, I take an active hand in feature planning and long-term project coordination, often bridging the gap between engineering teams and upper management by providing strategic technical guidance. I mentor junior and mid-level Java developers, focusing on skill development and engineering best practices.

A key focus of mine is developer experience — I’m passionate about optimizing internal workflows, reducing unnecessary overhead, and enabling teams to focus on meaningful, high-impact work.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Iowa City, Iowa, United States · On-site
positions.description:
I began my journey in this role as a software engineering intern focused on testing and quickly grew into a full-time engineer contributing across the entire product stack. My work centered around building a digital interface for tracking data collected by edge devices in the agritech space, helping surface meaningful trends through real-time data visualization.

A large portion of my work involved designing and developing Java-based modules to support asynchronous communication with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. I engineered mobile applications to interact with custom BLE hardware and implemented NFC and RFID functionality to streamline user navigation and access to relevant data displays. I also prototyped and developed firmware for various microcontrollers and helped architect the hardware and embedded software for a BLE gateway, including priority scheduling algorithms to optimize performance under load.

Beyond software development, I was actively involved in analyzing data trends, designing animated visualizations like heat maps, and exploring the relationships between variables to better understand underlying patterns. I worked closely with a cross-functional team in an Agile environment to bring features from concept to release, collaborating on everything from architecture decisions to field-level debugging.

This role gave me a strong foundation in embedded systems, BLE protocols, mobile app development, and data-centric interface design — and, most importantly, the experience of delivering complete solutions from prototype to production.
